structures.name: Skin, with simulated coat
structures.sourceLabel: outer surface of all source labels
structures.description: The outer surface of the union of all Digimouse labels, carried into the stance and smoothed. Moved to the simulated standing posture by rotating limb segments about joints read from the source CT. The lower hind legs are simulated shapes whose radii are measured from the leg tissue, because the scanned shanks lay pressed flat and the images end at the hind feet. The fur drawn on the surface is simulated, because the specimen is a nude mouse.
basis: Dogdas B, Stout D, Chatziioannou AF, Leahy RM. Digimouse: a 3D whole body mouse atlas from CT and cryosection data. Phys Med Biol 2007. doi:10.1088/0031-9155/52/3/003
Cook MJ. The Anatomy of the Laboratory Mouse. Academic Press, 1965; web edition at https://www.informatics.jax.org/cookbook/

structures.name: Skeletal muscle
structures.sourceLabel: none, traced from the source images
structures.description: Traced by automatic colour and density rules in the coregistered source photographs and CT, inside the residual label that the source leaves unsegmented. Red tissue of muscle density outside the abdominal cavity, including the trunk, neck and limbs. Individual muscles are not separated or named. Not reviewed by an anatomist. Moved to the simulated standing posture by rotating limb segments about joints read from the source CT.

structures.description: Traced by automatic colour and density rules in the coregistered source photographs and CT, inside the residual label that the source leaves unsegmented. structures.name: Blood-filled vessels
structures.sourceLabel: none, traced from the source images
structures.description: Traced by automatic colour and density rules in the coregistered source photographs and CT, inside the residual label that the source leaves unsegmented. Moved to the simulated standing posture by rotating limb segments about joints read from the source CT.

limitations: This is a constructed model and not a measurement of a living mouse. Each structure states whether it is source-labelled, traced from the source images or simulated.
The standing posture is simulated: the specimen was scanned spread flat, postmortem and frozen, and its limbs were rotated about their joints to an estimated stance.
Simulated structures follow published anatomical descriptions and are not measured from this specimen or any other.
Anatomical orientation, laterality and physical calibration remain unverified, and nothing here has had independent anatomical review.

specimen.description: Measured layers from one 28 g normal nude male mouse, with a simulated posture and simulated layers. The coat is simulated, because the specimen is hairless.
